newsitem.title: USA: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Feb prel 97.4.
newsitem.headline: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Feb prel 97.4.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for February held steady at 97.4, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component fell to 104.8 in the preliminary February report against the 106.8 reading in the final January.
The expectations index rose to 92.7 in the February preliminary data versus 91.3 in the final January, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
